versions.changelog:
Initial release introducing a complete AI-powered project bootstrap layer.

- Adds a reusable 3-agent (Architect, Builder, Tester) operating system for SaaS, dashboard, mobile, or API projects.
- Generates AGENTS.md, agent instructions, documentation templates, and prompt templates in a standardized format.
- Detects project type and preserves existing structure, focusing changes on the AI workflow layer.
- Ensures safety by avoiding overwrites and unnecessary dependencies.
- Prepares the repo for standardized AI-driven planning, building, and testing workflows.
